[Direct Supply](https://www.directsupply.com/company/about) is an employee-owned private company. It does not have a single outside corporate owner or public shareholders. It was founded in 1985 by [Robert “Bob” Hillis](https://urbanmilwaukee.com/people/robert-hillis/), who continues to serve as the company's President and CEO. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Direct_Supply)
